name: Sign-In Follow-Up
office_task: Take the open-home sign-in sheet, follow up only the people who said yes with a message I approved, sort their replies, and draft the vendor's report from them.
systems_of_record: the open-home sign-in register, exported from the sign-in app or the agency CRM, or the paper sheet typed up, which issues the document_id and the listing_id each row belongs to
the agent's mail and SMS sender, which holds the approved drafts, the sends and the replies (message_id)
the report store the agent and the vendor open, which issues the report_id per version

emits.write: the week's vendor report for one listing (attendee, follow-up, reply and class counts, price comments word for word, themes citing their replies, no names or contact details), drafted to the agent as a new version and sent to the vendor only once the agent approved that version
emits.readback: the report store returns a version for the listing, and reading the listing's latest report back returns that version, its counts and verbatim comments, and whether it reached the vendor; no version back means nothing was written

emits.write: an exception naming the agent who owns it: a register row with no name, no way to reach them or no open, a row with no consent at sign-in, the same person at two opens of one listing, an offer, a complaint, or a reply that fits no class, each with the row or the reply word for word
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the register row or reply it is about, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

port_of.original_name: Automate Real Estate Open House Follow-ups with SignSnapHome, HubSpot, and Twilio
